:new: New project intention · #5 The Reedy model category structure

Let C be a Reedy category and D a model category structure. The purpose of this project is to formalize the Reedy model category structure on the category of functors from C to D. (E.g. if C is the opposite of the simplex category and D the category of simplicial sets, this will give a model category structure on the category of bisimplicial sets.)
The intended result is theorem C.5.14 at https://emilyriehl.github.io/files/elements.pdf
The goal is to eventually upstream this formalization to mathlib.
The project would welcome non-AI generated PRs by people not involved in the Formalizing Higher Categories workshop.
